description:
Subject: DevInit Setup for .NET Web Project with Node.js Frontend  

The DevInit configuration (based on the schema at https://json.schemastore.org/devinit.schema-2.0.json) is intended for a .NET web project that includes a Node.js front‑end. The overall purpose of this file is described as “DevInit configuration for a .NET web project with Node.js frontend”.

The initialization sequence performs the following actions in order:

1. **require-nodejs** – ensures that Node.js is available on the machine (comment: “Ensure Node.js is available”).  
2. **npm-install** – runs the command `npm install` with the option `--no-audit` to install NPM dependencies without performing an audit (comment: “Install NPM dependencies”).  
3. **require-dotnetcoresdk** – checks that the .NET Core SDK is installed (comment: “Check .NET Core SDK”).  
4. **dotnet-restore** – restores all .NET packages required by the solution (comment: “Restore .NET packages”).  
5. **enable-iis** – enables the IIS Windows feature so the web project can be served (comment: “Enable IIS feature”).
